name: Song of Solomon
lede: The twenty-second book of the Bible, in full: the Song of songs, which is Solomon's — the bride in the vineyards, the beloved like a roe upon the mountains, the winter past and the voice of the turtle-dove, a garden shut up, and love strong as death — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: I Am a Rose of Sharon
books.blurb: The Song of songs, which is Solomon's: I am black, but comely, as the tents of Kedar; tell me, O thou whom my soul loveth, where thou feedest thy flock; I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys; his banner over me was love; the voice of my beloved, leaping upon the mountains — rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away, for, lo, the winter is past; the little foxes; my beloved is mine, and I am his.

books.name: A Garden Shut Up
books.blurb: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth; who is this that cometh up from the wilderness like pillars of smoke? — the litter of Solomon and the crown of his espousals; behold, thou art fair, my love; come with me from Lebanon; a garden shut up, a spring shut up, a fountain sealed; awake, O north wind; I was asleep, but my heart waked; and my beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
